facts.business: Shiva Mills Limited is engaged in the manufacturing of cotton yarn and generation of wind power for captive consumption.

capacity_or_capex.item: Capital expenditure on property, plant and equipment including capital advances

guidance_or_targets.statement: The Company expects to maintain stable operations with the possibility of achieving a marginal profit during the year.

key_risks: Dependence on demand for yarn in domestic and export markets
facts.related_party_note: During the year, all transactions with the related parties were entered at arm's length. No material contracts or arrangements at arm's length basis.
